tone: pastoral, exhortational, polemical, Christ-centered, participatory, and triumphant
target_reader: religion-naive adults and older adolescents near grade 6
translation_identity: firmly dynamic-equivalence, NLT-like in readability but independent
test_purpose: Human Editor-approved source-side Passage-Sense packet for blind A/B/C drafting of Colossians 2:6-15.

sealed_context.instruction: Use only SBLGNT Greek, this approved source-side brief, and unit Matrix alerts. Comparison translations, prior FLT English, conversational drafts, and editor benchmarks are forbidden from blind-worker input.

copyright_advisory.instruction: Run advisory string-spotting only after all three independent candidates exist.

governing_rules: Preserve the as-you-received-Him / so-live-in-Him correspondence of Col.2.6.
Preserve the completed rooting / ongoing building contrast and deliberate mixed metaphors of Col.2.7.
Do not condemn philosophy as a discipline in general.
At Col.2.8 preserve stoicheia with deliberately underdetermined guidance: the elemental principles that govern this world. Do not resolve as spirit powers or basic teachings.
At Col.2.9-10 preserve the pleroma / pepleromenoi handoff where clear; pepleromenoi is a settled perfect-passive state, never aspirational or progressive.
The pler- family has no corpus-level English policy yet; flag the gap rather than inventing one.
Somatikos has bodily/incarnational sense primary but exact range contested.
At Col.2.11 do not make the circumcision of Christ sound like Jesus' infant circumcision; preserve the physical-body force and Col.1.22 echo of to soma tes sarkos; sinful nature is forbidden.
The buried-with / raised-with / made-alive-with Christ element in Col.2.12-13 is load-bearing and must remain audible in all three.
At Col.2.12 the faith-genitive is contested; faith in God's working is only the working ruling and a Transparency Note is required.
At Col.2.13-15 hold one subject consistently. God is the working construal; mid-sentence drift between God and Christ is blocking.
At Col.2.14 do not identify cheirographon with the Mosaic law; the bare-dative relation of tois dogmasin remains unresolved and English must survive either relation.
At Col.2.15 preserve public victorious triumph without requiring triumphal procession; en auto is contested, with through the cross only a low-confidence working ruling.

verses.greek: Ὡς οὖν παρελάβετε τὸν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν τὸν κύριον, ἐν αὐτῷ περιπατεῖτε,
ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ ἐποικοδομούμενοι ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ βεβαιούμενοι τῇ πίστει καθὼς ἐδιδάχθητε, περισσεύοντες ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ.
Βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς ἔσται ὁ συλαγωγῶν διὰ τῆς φιλοσοφίας καὶ κενῆς ἀπάτης κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, κατὰ τὰ στοιχεῖα τοῦ κόσμου καὶ οὐ κατὰ Χριστόν·
ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ κατοικεῖ πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τῆς θεότητος σωματικῶς,
καὶ ἐστὲ ἐν αὐτῷ πεπληρωμένοι, ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας,
ἐν ᾧ καὶ περιετμήθητε περιτομῇ ἀχειροποιήτῳ ἐν τῇ ἀπεκδύσει τοῦ σώματος τῆς σαρκός, ἐν τῇ περιτομῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
συνταφέντες αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ βαπτισμῷ, ἐν ᾧ καὶ συνηγέρθητε διὰ τῆς πίστεως τῆς ἐνεργείας τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν·
καὶ ὑμᾶς νεκροὺς ὄντας ἐν τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ τῇ ἀκροβυστίᾳ τῆς σαρκὸς ὑμῶν, συνεζωοποίησεν ὑμᾶς σὺν αὐτῷ· χαρισάμενος ἡμῖν πάντα τὰ παραπτώματα,
ἐξαλείψας τὸ καθ’ ἡμῶν χειρόγραφον τοῖς δόγμασιν ὃ ἦν ὑπεναντίον ἡμῖν, καὶ αὐτὸ ἦρκεν ἐκ τοῦ μέσου προσηλώσας αὐτὸ τῷ σταυρῷ·
ἀπεκδυσάμενος τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰς ἐξουσίας ἐδειγμάτισεν ἐν παρρησίᾳ, θριαμβεύσας αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐτῷ.

passage_argument: As the believers received Christ Jesus the Lord, so they must continue living in Him; v7 develops that life through completed rooting, ongoing building, strengthening in the taught faith, and overflowing thanksgiving.
Verse 8 warns against capture by empty deceptive teaching grounded in human tradition and the deliberately underdetermined elemental principles that govern this world rather than Christ.
Verses 9-10 ground sufficiency in Christ's divine fullness and the believers' already-established cognate state in Him.
Verses 11-13 describe Christ-related circumcision and the load-bearing buried-with / raised-with / made-alive-with Christ chain.

Verses 13-15 continue under one working divine subject through forgiveness, removal of the hostile record, and public victory over rulers and authorities, while key syntactic/antecedent questions remain transparently contested.

proposition_map.proposition: As they received Christ Jesus the Lord, so they must continue living in Him, rooted, built up, strengthened in the taught faith, and overflowing with thanksgiving.

They must not be carried off by empty deceptive teaching grounded in human tradition and the elemental principles that govern this world rather than Christ, without resolving the precise ontology of the stoicheia.
All the fullness of deity dwells bodily in Christ, and believers already stand in a settled cognate state in Him, who is head over every ruler and authority.
In Christ they received non-human circumcision, were buried with Him, and were raised with Him through faith in God's working, while the faith-genitive remains contested.
God made them alive with Christ, forgave transgressions, erased and removed the hostile written record, and nailed it to the cross without requiring a settled relation for the dative decrees.
Under the one-subject working construal, God stripped/disarmed rulers and authorities, exposed them publicly, and triumphed over them; the antecedent of en auto remains contested.
